dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Oh— hey. Um… thanks for coming in. I didn’t want to talk out there.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I know I sounded… intense. I’m not trying to be weird, I just…

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: …okay, this is already coming out wrong. Never mind. Forget it.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Maxwell. It’s fine. Just tell me.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Right. Okay. So— I made something. A game. It’s nothing big, I just…

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I wanted to show you. If you want. You don’t have to. Obviously.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Okay. Um… when you’re ready… hit the first key.
